description: This PHP script interacts with a Redmine issue tracking system via a custom API wrapper. It sets up connections to multiple Redmine sites, selects one based on an index, and adds an issue with specified details such as subject and project.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A class representing the connection to a Redmine server, capable of adding issues.

methods.name: addIssueFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Method to add a new issue to Redmine using an XML object.
